create_atari_env: create an Atari environment with frame skipping and resizing using make_atari_env
lookup_atari_spec: lookup an Atari environment specification by name using atari_env_by_name
build_atari_spec: build an AtariSpec object with a name, env_id, and optional default_timeout
review_atari_envs_list: review the ATARI_ENVS list to see all registered Atari environment specifications
test_make_atari_env: test make_atari_env with a config object that has env_framestack and env_frameskip attributes
